actor: root adopting post-blind source genealogy audit
unit: conservatively deduplicated primary-source work/function families; not independent mechanisms, successes or historical availability

families.label: Node-RED flow editing
families.reason: Four acquisitions repeat the same UI guide; PUT flow is a separate document and configuration path, conservatively folded into the same flow-editing family.

families.label: Microsoft menu naming guidance
families.reason: First-party Windows design guidance contains the operative task-label and object-property convention.

families.label: Chrome CSS diagnostics
families.reason: First-party documentation describes its own resolved-style diagnostic facility.

families.label: W3C 2015 tab-panel guidance
families.reason: The original substantive section read is S4. S2 exposes status/contents only and S3 repeats an incomplete opening segment.

families.label: Node-RED credential representation
families.reason: Both arms read the same official editor/runtime credential contract despite different original_work_id strings.

families.label: Vault partial secret update
families.reason: Official documentation describes Vault own partial-update and read-modify-write behavior.

families.label: Auxx secret lifecycle implementation
families.reason: A first-party engineering account describes its own mask filtering and nested preserving merge; this is not a generic tutorial paraphrasing another protocol.

families.label: Vendure secret-field contract
families.reason: Original S2 read only identity/version; S4 read create/update placeholder semantics and must carry the one credit.

families.label: CSS UI pointer-events guidance
families.reason: Both arms eventually read section 6.2; earlier metadata/anchor acquisitions do not substantiate hit-testing. The earliest qualifying original body read is R4-B-S1-R2.

families.label: React Flow interaction APIs and classes
families.reason: Selection/deletion controls, utility classes and component interaction props are intentionally merged into one broad product-function family; the unpkg mirror is excluded.

families.label: React Flow connection handles and insertion
families.reason: Repeated handles guide and separate addEdge insertion validation are folded into one connection family. Failed hook-detail fetch contributes zero.

families.label: ELK port sizing and spacing
families.reason: The returned candidate rests on node-size options. Spacing and layered-algorithm pages are substantive nonfinal support, folded in without extra count.

families.label: yFiles parallel-edge router
families.reason: The vendor API and first-party source demo describe the same router. Trigger/scope behavior in the demo adds detail, not a second router.

families.label: Chromium touchpad encoder
families.reason: Two revisions share the same file/function genealogy. The first qualifying original read is R6-B-S5; commit metadata is supporting and the failed change fetch is uncredited.

families.label: D3 zoom component
families.reason: Official component reference gives filter-versus-listener-removal and wheel scaling behavior.

families.label: Chrome passive-wheel intervention
families.reason: First-party browser policy article documents Chrome own root-listener passivity change.

families.label: Chromium PDF gesture adapter
families.reason: Official source implements a separate consumer-side adapter with scaling, accumulation and gesture lifecycle.

families.label: nonfinal_support
families.reason: Substantive official node-authoring background, but not returned as a final candidate and not verified as the core-menu mechanism.

families.label: rewritten_discovery_excluded
families.reason: Original acquisition explicitly reports a tool-rewritten summary after redirect. A later cleaner reread cannot retroactively qualify that sealed acquisition as primary discovery.

families.label: failed_acquisition
families.reason: Project wiki fetch failed; no substantive primary body.

families.label: nonfinal_support
families.reason: Same nonfinal node-authoring background as R1-A-S2; no additional allotted count.

families.label: held_unverified_original_claim
families.reason: Original initial read was source identity/line listing. Later S6 claims operative code, but independent review could not substantiate it. Hold rather than treating metadata as code evidence.

families.label: held_unverified_original_claim
families.reason: Original ledger claims a substantive section; independent operative verification failed. Conservative exclusion is uncertainty, not a finding that the original read was fabricated or never occurred.
